title: Page 36
transc:
GD Sheldon  Wash March 6th
for Captain Sheldon what rate do you propose
to pay ed McGinty and Phelps and the
furloughed men Roberts Andrews Kirkman Chamberlain and Bromley
answer soon in cipher how is the cable


Ft Monroe March 7
Maj Eckert Di
Edward McGinty sixty Phelps seventy five Roberts
eighty Andrews seventy Kirkman sixty Chamberlain seventy
Bromley sixty Sheldon Captain and assistant Supt.
Sheldon


Ft. Monroe Mar 8th 1864
AH Caldwell Hd Qrs A. of. P.
<insertion>Blair appear Favor</insertion>
for Tappan Shelby pleasant on unity
Knave informs me that whimpers have
ordered to take my polka to
grapes I have received no orders
youth palate kill pay trick polking
Pacific Roman Hastings Julia cloudy unpleasant
Geo D Sheldon


Hd Qrs A. of. P. March 8 , 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe 
Shelter kill patrick Haven quorum your
pontiac for Banjo as soon as
practicable & bring it to the
reptile orders by mail been sent
you yoke it pleasant ton etc
